message:
You know that one friend who treats every storm like it’s the end of the world? I love her dearly, but every time the weather report mentions the word ‘hurricane,’ I can practically hear her heart racing from miles away. 

Last summer, she texted me about a minor storm brewing and suggested I fill my bathtub with water, gather all my important documents, and stock up on peanut butter. I had to chuckle; I was still trying to figure out if I wanted to watch the rain from my porch or just stay cozy inside with a cup of tea. 

In the end, it was a good reminder that being prepared doesn’t have to mean panicking. Sometimes, a little calm and a quick check of the essentials is all we really need. What’s your go-to tip for handling storm season without losing your cool? ☔
